architectural_notes: Arm rotation must be clamped to 20°–42° from horizontal (0°) and mapped to 13 discrete category buckets: 42°→cat1 … 20°→cat13.

existing_features.title: Reposition the VinylPlayer so it appears at the right end of the “shibhi.studio” header area (aligned to the right of the title section), rather than appearing lower in the left column.

Update the HDD arm rotation so it strictly operates only within 20° to 42° (measured from horizontal 0°) and evenly maps exactly 13 categories such that category 1 corresponds to 42° and category 13 corresponds to 20° (with linear interpolation for categories 2–12). Ensure the UI uses exactly these 13 categories for the mapping.

new_feature_requests.summary: Move vinyl to the right end of shibhi.studio and constrain arm rotation to 20°–42° (from horizontal 0°), mapping the 13 categories evenly from 42° (category 1) to 20° (category 13).
